title: Do synchronized training-only event cues survive the bounded weak-alignment envelope?
subtitle: Cue-free simulator-oracle grounding; synchronized minus matched control
input_policy: One validated local aggregate projection only; no bundle, seed, draw, model, item, window, empirical cell, text, media, or restricted payload input.

layout.rows: Five range families, each with absent, shuffled, time-shifted, and corrupted comparators
layout.mark: Point at mean effect with a line from the one-sided 95% lower bound to the mean
layout.decision_banner: POSITIVE_PROTOTYPE_EFFECT or VALID_NULL_OR_NONPROMOTION only after complete validation

caption_shell: Mean paired synchronized-minus-control lift and one-sided 95% lower bound across 40 synthetic corpus effects. Every displayed value is from the validated aggregate projection. Filled marks pass all frozen directional gates; open marks do not. [DECISION_SENTENCE]
mandatory_footer: Synthetic prototype only • cue absent at evaluation • simulator-oracle truth • ChildLens aggregate calibration is model-derived, not human gold • no infant or naturalistic acquisition claim
